## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)
- [ ] docs (documentation update)
- [ ] refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] chore (maintenance)
- [ ] test (tests only)

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] Manual verification completed

## Screenshots / Logs (if applicable)

Add screenshots, logs, or API examples when UI or behavior changed.

## Risks

List potential regressions, migrations, or rollout concerns.

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows repository conventions
- [ ] Documentation updated (if needed)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
